rewrite.before:
What you worked out by the end of trial 3:
  [1] Patch map: upper cyan r4-8 c9-13, green r5-9 c16-20, lower cyan r11-15 c6-10, west cyan r5-9 c1-5, purple r12-14 c13-15, yellow r13-15 c18-20. East wall col 22.
  [2] Respawn is in the NE near green; west cyan is far from spawn.
  [3] The orchard dies by about t100-110 in every trial, so nearly all points come in the first ~90 steps.
  [4] Green and cyan ripe are the valuable apples. Unripe, over-ripe and yellow pay little.
  [5] Waiting for a whole patch to ripen fails: west cyan went all over-ripe by t47 while I waited, then rivals stripped the regrowth.
  [6] Rivals (B, C, E) strip every patch bare, including unripe, so the 3+ hanging regrowth plan never survives. Eat ripe apples as soon as they are in reach.
  [7] No patch stays quiet: E contested west cyan at t10, and B, C and E crowded it by t70. C strips green by t25-45.
  [8] E zaps aggressively. I was zapped at t10 and t34 in trial 3 and 7 times in trial 2. Never stand in a rival's facing line.
  [9] The nearest patch to spawn (green, then upper cyan) is worth grabbing early; long walks cost ripe apples.
  [10] Rotted cells regrow on their own. After the rot wave (~t47-60), fresh unripe apples ripen about 20 steps later, which is a second harvest window.
  [11] Trial 3 scored only 13; the conservative strategy underperformed.

What you meant to try this trial:
  [12] From spawn, eat ripe apples at green or upper cyan immediately instead of walking west.
  [13] Keep facing the direction rivals approach from and zap them first when they line up in my beam at a patch I'm eating.
  [14] Time a return to the patch that rotted around t47-60 to catch its ripe regrowth near t70-80.
  [15] Test purple ripe once if it is cheaply in reach, to learn its value.

Notes you have added since:
  [16] t5: T4: B, D and E all spawn near upper cyan/green at the start. Everything is unripe until ~t17, so wait near upper cyan and keep out of their beam lines.
  [17] t28: T4 t28: E stripped green by t28 (it arrived ~t25). Green ripens ~t20-25; be there by t20 or skip it for upper cyan.
  [18] t38: T4 t38: upper cyan, lower cyan and purple all went over-ripe by ~t36-38 (rivals ate the few ripe ones). Plan: let the over-ripe rot (~t55), then harvest the rot-regrowth when it ripens ~t72-80.
  [19] t43: T4 t42: purple over-ripe pays 1 point, as much as ripe cyan/green. When the orchard goes over-ripe (~t36-40), strip the purple patch (r12-14 c13-15).
  [20] t47: T4 t47: purple stripped by t47 (D ate 3). Plan: zap rivals at lower cyan, let its over-ripe rot ~t56, harvest ripe regrowth ~t75.
  [21] t60: T4 t60: zapped at t49 at lower cyan and respawned at (0,9). Upper cyan rot regrowth ripens ~t70; wait at (3,10).
  [22] t73: T4 t73: the rot-regrowth wave ripened ~t66-73 at upper and lower cyan, confirming note [10]. Be in place at a patch by t65.
  [23] t88: T4 t88: lower cyan was stripped bare by t88 after its ~t70-80 regrowth wave (E and I ate it). Next, check west cyan, which rivals visit less late in the trial.
  [24] t98: T4 t98: west cyan was stripped by D, C and E by t96, so late in the trial it is no refuge. Leave over-ripe apples to rot (rotted cells regrow on their own) instead of eating them for 0.25.
  [25] t110: T4 t110: the whole orchard was bare by ~t105. Only rotted cells regrow late, so watch those cells for late apples.
